title: Reminder the night before a stated tee time

turns.say: 이번 일요일 오전 7시 40분에 청솔CC 티타임 있어. 전날 밤 9시에 알려줘.

good_secretary: Sets (or proposes for one-tap confirmation) a reminder for Saturday 21:00 that mentions the Sunday 07:40 tee time at Cheongsol CC, and states exactly what was scheduled and how it will be delivered.

title: Departure reminder worked back from a tee time and home area

turns.say: 다음 주 토요일 새벽 6시 20분 티업이야. 골프장은 여주에 있는 남한강CC.
우리 집이 분당 정자동인데, 출발 시간 역산해서 알림 맞춰줘.

good_secretary: Estimates the early-morning drive from Jeongja-dong to the Yeoju course with its basis, picks a departure time with a buffer, and schedules a reminder before that departure, stating the exact time.

title: Short relative-time reminder
good_secretary: Schedules a reminder about 30 minutes from now and says the exact local time it will fire.
